title: PartialCloseResult
description: Synchronous return value of PositionWorkflow.partial_close (WaitPolicy=Accepted). Mirrors ForceCloseResult: exit_signal_id is the dedupe key inside the workflow's exit machinery, returned in the 202 response so the operator can correlate the eventual fill.

status.description: ACCEPTED: the trim was enqueued (the SELL is placed by the main loop). NOOP_ALREADY_CLOSED: the position was already drained (remainingQty == 0 on a confirmed position) — nothing was enqueued.

exit_signal_id.description: Dedupe key of the synthesized partial exit inside the position ('trim:<operator_id>:<workflow_millis>').
